leads.venue: Magical Bridge Playground at Rengstorff Park
leads.address: 201 S. Rengstorff Ave, Mountain View, CA 94040
leads.description: Live music, magic, puppetry & balloons on the inclusive playground stage — a short afternoon show little ones can watch, then play.
leads.tips: Magical Bridge’s calendar lists remaining named performances Wed Sep 16, Sep 30 & Oct 14. Series copy says 4:00–5:00 PM. This is not the 10:00 AM Bookmobile storytime. Confirm the date you go on magicalbridge.org/calendar (an older series page also lists other September/October dates).
leads.leadNotes: Thursday pre-run 2026-09-15. Calendar named acts; hours from series page 4–5 PM. Do not mix with Magical Bridge Storytime rows already live.

leads.title: Second Saturday at Gamble Garden
leads.description: Soil-by-feel station, pot-painting crafts, scavenger hunts & librarian storytime — a free garden morning for little ones to explore and make.
leads.tips: Register for a timed entry slot at 10:00, 10:30, or 11:00 AM, then check in at a Welcome Table. October theme is soil / Hispanic and Latinx Heritage Month.
leads.leadNotes: Thursday pre-run 2026-09-15. Official Gamble October Second Saturday page. Sep 12 Second Saturday already live — this is the next month.
